design.quote: We reviewed recent literature to investigate the effect of cannabinoid use, particularly CBD and THC on aging and longevity. By synthesizing findings from preclinical models, clinical studies, and real-world evidence, we aimed to elucidate the potential of cannabinoids, in fostering healthy aging, mitigate age-related decline, and promote well-being in older populations.
design.text: A systematic review of preclinical models, clinical studies, and real-world evidence investigating the effect of cannabinoid use on aging and longevity.

findings.quote: Lifetime cannabis use, especially when initiated early, may exacerbate cognitive decline and aging-related vulnerabilities, while cannabis use initiated or continued during aging might produce distinct or less severe outcomes.
